title: Tessie Vehicle Snapshot Battery Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tessie:vehicle battery_pct=*
| stats sum(battery_pct) as total_value, avg(battery_pct) as avg_value by model
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks model values by total and average battery percent across Tessie vehicle snapshot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `battery_pct` values for each Tessie vehicle snapshot event and review total and average battery percent by model.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total battery percent.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which model shows the biggest battery percent numbers in your Tessie vehicle snapshot data.
